# Green Engine license FAQ (BUSL-1.1)

This FAQ explains how VeyrForge interprets the [Business Source License 1.1](LICENSE) Additional Use Grant for Green Engine. **It does not replace or modify the license.** If anything here conflicts with [LICENSE](LICENSE), the LICENSE controls.

Contact for commercial / alternative licensing: **licensing@veyrforge.com**.

## Source-available, not open source

Green Engine is **source-available** under BUSL-1.1. It is not an OSI-approved open-source license until the Change License applies.

## Change Date

**Change Date:** 2029-07-24  
**Change License:** Apache License, Version 2.0

Under the standard BSL terms, conversion for a given version happens on the **Change Date or the fourth anniversary of the first public distribution of that version under this License, whichever comes first**.

## Allowed / not allowed (plain language)

| Example | Allowed? |
| --- | --- |
| Personal projects | Yes |
| Company-internal use | Yes |
| Paid client development (using Green Engine yourself / for customers’ software) | Yes |
| Private modifications | Yes |
| Publishing modifications under BUSL-1.1 | Yes |
| Creating integrations and plugins | Yes |
| Selling support or consulting | Yes |
| Offering hosted Green Engine / competing inference access | Commercial license required |
| Selling a renamed fork | Commercial license required |
| Embedding Green Engine as the main feature of another paid product | Commercial license required |
| Using Green Engine to build an unrelated commercial application | Yes |

In short: you may use and modify Green Engine for personal and internal business purposes (including employees and contractors acting on your behalf). You may not offer Green Engine (or a substantially similar substitute) to third parties as a hosted, managed, embedded, or distributed product or service whose primary purpose is to replace Green Engine.

Using Green Engine to develop, test, maintain, review, or operate software for yourself or your customers is allowed, provided those customers are not offered access to Green Engine itself as a product or service.
